summary: Analyzes orbitofrontal cortex (ORBvl) neural activity during the inter-trial interval to decode the subject's internal prior probability of stimulus presentation, benchmarking against a Bayes-optimal observer model.
use_when: decode task prior from ORBvl population activity
calculate correlation between decoded prior and Bayes-optimal prior
estimate trial-by-trial prior probability from ORBvl spiking data
quantify ORBvl representation of task statistics using corrected R-squared
generate plot of decoded versus Bayes-optimal prior in ORBvl
avoid_when: Neural and behavioral measurements cannot be aligned on a common time base
The intended conclusion requires causal inference from an observational association alone
Leakage-safe cross-validation groups or labels are unavailable
